content.premise: spec-0038 probe 2: the recorded spec-0031 finding, demonstrated - a stage-5 runtime region is a box CENTRED on a prefab anchor with unsigned half-extents, so the cell one below an anchor (a deck under riders, a tide slab over a walk plane, a basin behind a wall) cannot be named. The general region language (box min/max in a frame, union/intersect/subtract) exists one stage away in stage 7 and stage 5 cannot see it.
